charts.title: International Student Visa Issuance Drop: Summer 2025 vs. Summer 2024
charts.sourceText: Inside Higher Ed / U.S. State Department data, March 2026
charts.footnote: Summer months (June-August) are peak visa issuance season. The June pause in student visa appointments -- during which the State Dept. implemented social media reviews -- caused the sharpest single-month decline on record.

charts.title: University Federal Settlement Payments: Ivy League and Peers
charts.sourceText: The Chronicle of Higher Education / The Hill / AP, 2025-2026
charts.footnote: Columbia's $200M goes to U.S. Treasury; Brown's $50M directed to RI workforce development orgs over 10 years; Cornell's up to $100M per Chronicle; Northwestern $75M; Penn $0 (no monetary fine). Harvard negotiations ongoing with administration demanding $1B.
